qualifier: intercalated-disc adhesion, gap junctions and T-tubule structure
name: Ventricular cardiomyocyte coupling, excitability and T-tubule structure
rationale: All members concern the electrical and structural coupling of ventricular cardiomyocytes; unlike the calcium-handling and conduction-phase confusables, this theme has gap junction activity, cardiomyocyte adhesion and T-tubule organization.

qualifier: ATP-dependent remodeler complexes (BAF, CHD, NuRD) and protein acetylation
name: ATP-dependent chromatin remodeling complexes and protein acetylation
rationale: Most members are BAF/CHD/NuRD/ChAHP remodeler assembly, nucleosome organization and histone/protein acetylation, which separates the theme from confusables centred on chromosome condensation, histone methylation, DNA methylation or HDAC/SUMO repression; a few members (UCH proteinases, centriole replication, organism emergence) are peripheral.

qualifier: iodide and sulfate transport via SLC26 exchangers and PAPS activation
name: Thyroid hormone and iodide/sulfate anion transport
rationale: Members combine thyroid hormone generation, transport and signaling with iodide, sulfate and oxalate anion transport (SLC26, NIS, PAPS), while the confusables share the thyroid core but add peroxide, selenium or sulfonation instead of anion exchange.

qualifier: splicing, nuclear export, decay and ribosome-associated quality control
name: mRNA splicing, export, decay and ribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover snRNP/spliceosome function, 3'-end processing, mRNA export, NMD and other decay routes and stalled-ribosome rescue, distinguishing the theme from the rRNA/Pol I-III ribosome biogenesis confusable and the lncRNA or N-end-rule neighbours.

qualifier: microglial proliferation, migration and amyloid fibril formation control
name: Microglial activation, proliferation and amyloid fibril clearance
rationale: All members concern microglial responses (activation, proliferation, migration, cytotoxicity, glial survival) and amyloid fibril/amyloid-beta and apoptotic-cell clearance; confusables lack either the amyloid fibril members or the microglial proliferation/migration members.

qualifier: injured axon regeneration and neuron survival/death
name: p75 neurotrophin receptor signaling and injured axon regeneration
rationale: Members are p75NTR ligand binding, proteolysis and survival/death outputs plus axon growth, sprouting and regeneration after injury, separating the theme from Trk/dependence-receptor confusables and from collateral-sprouting confusables.

qualifier: cystine transport (cystinuria SLC3A1/SLC7A9)
name: Plasma membrane solute carriers with renal cystine transport
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane/SLC transporter gene modules plus L-cystine transport and its cystinuria defects, unlike confusables built on neutral amino acid, proline/glycine, peptide or urate transport.

qualifier: leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone receptor signaling
name: Leptin, ghrelin and growth hormone control of feeding and growth
rationale: Members span feeding behaviour, nutrient-level responses, leptin and ghrelin signaling and GH/IGF-driven organism growth, distinguishing the theme from glucocorticoid, prolactin-receptor and gut peptide GPCR confusables.

qualifier: sensory-driven behavior and prepulse inhibition
name: Vocal, social and sensorimotor gating behaviors
rationale: Members are behavioural processes (vocalization and vocal learning, observational learning, intraspecies interaction, auditory/visual/mechanosensory behaviour, prepulse inhibition) with striatum development, unlike the MECP2 and locomotor/proprioception confusables.

qualifier: nuclear receptor transcription and receptor SUMOylation
name: Thyroid hormone nuclear receptor transcriptional signaling
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone receptor signaling and responses plus nuclear receptor transcription and SUMOylation, distinguishing it from confusables about thyroid hormone synthesis/transport, steroid receptors or LXR targets.

qualifier: KIT receptor mutants
name: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
rationale: All members describe KIT mutant binding of and resistance to TKIs, separating the theme from PDGFR and FLT3 resistance confusables and from KIT mutant signaling.

qualifier: phosphatase-mediated negative feedback, AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 output
name: ERK MAPK negative feedback, AP-1 and IL-6 signaling
rationale: Members combine ERK1/2, ERK5 and atypical MAPK activation with their dephosphorylation and negative feedback plus AP-1 and IL-6/STAT3 outputs, unlike confusables centred on TAK1-JNK/p38 activation, TNF/NF-kB early genes, or oncogenic RAS/RAF activation.

core: Motile cilium and sperm axoneme assembly
qualifier: tubulin folding and polyglutamylation
name: Sperm and motile cilia axoneme assembly, tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members are axonemal dynein arm and central apparatus assembly, multiciliogenesis, sperm tail structures and tubulin folding/glutamylation/severing, distinguishing the theme from centrosome, intraflagellar transport and sperm motility confusables.

qualifier: endothelial and blood-brain barrier
name: Tight junction regulation of endothelial barriers
rationale: All members regulate bicellular tight junction assembly, disassembly or composition and endothelial barrier function, while the confusables concern adherens junctions, cadherins and apical polarity.

qualifier: sperm motility, capacitation and acrosome reaction
name: Sperm motility, acrosome reaction and fertilization
rationale: Members cover sperm capacitation, motility, acrosome formation and exocytosis, zona pellucida binding and egg activation, distinguishing the theme from germline/zygotic and axoneme-assembly confusables.

qualifier: CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members are proximal and downstream TCR signaling, CD28 costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and IL-2 production, unlike the BCR confusable and the ITK/PKC T cell differentiation confusables.

name: Neuronal dendrite arborization and branching
rationale: All three members concern growth and branching of dendritic arbors, whereas confusables concern filopodia, postsynaptic actin and synapse structure.

qualifier: RAC1-3 and RHOG cycles driving Arp2/3 lamellipodia
name: RAC and RHOG GTPase cycles driving lamellipodial actin
rationale: Members are RAC/RHOG GTPase cycles and their WAVE/Arp2/3, lamellipodium and NADPH oxidase effectors, distinguishing the theme from CDC42/RHOA-centred confusables and from Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis.

qualifier: Rho GTPase (RHOH, Cdc42) control of lymphocyte polarity
name: Rho GTPase-driven immunological synapse and lymphocyte polarity
rationale: Members concern immunological synapse formation, T cell polarity, raft localization and lymphocyte aggregation via RHOH/Cdc42 and CORO1A-DEF6, unlike confusables about lymphocyte homing, integrin adhesion or dendritic cell activation.

qualifier: gonadotropin and activin control of follicle development
name: Gonadotropin and activin regulation of folliculogenesis and gonad function
rationale: Members span FSH/LH/GnRH, activin and AMH signaling, follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, oocyte maturation and Sertoli/Leydig development, distinguishing the theme from germ cell migration, sex determination and progesterone synthesis confusables.

qualifier: de novo synthesis, NTP sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: De novo purine synthesis, NTP sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members are de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/GTP synthesis, NUDT nucleoside triphosphate hydrolysis and azathioprine/TPMT methylation, unlike confusables on nucleoside transport, purine salvage or pyrimidine metabolism.

qualifier: regulation of peptide loading
name: Regulation of MHC class II peptide antigen presentation
rationale: Members are regulation of peptide antigen processing/presentation and MHC-II peptide assembly plus antigen-presentation gene modules, while confusables cover exogenous antigen processing, lipid presentation and DC/monocyte surface signatures.

qualifier: with non-histone lysine and arginine methylation
name: DNA and protein methylation in Polycomb gene silencing
rationale: Members combine DNA/CpG methylation, PRC2, facultative heterochromatin and imprinting with lysine/arginine methylation of histones, p53 and RUNX1/E2F6 partners, unlike confusables centred on WDR5/MLL lysine methylation, demethylases or chromatin remodelers.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation balance
rationale: All members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis or stem cell proliferation, whereas confusables concern skin appendage morphogenesis, barrier formation or wound migration.

qualifier: suppression of spreading, lamellipodia and Rac/Rho signaling
name: Inhibition of cell-matrix adhesion, spreading and Rac/Rho signaling
rationale: All members negatively regulate integrin-based adhesion, spreading, ruffles/lamellipodia, Rac/Rho signaling or epithelial migration, unlike confusables about positive wound migration, invadopodia or CDC42 leading-edge formation.
